name:
Article 1 – § 1 – point 6; Regulation (EC) No 261/2004 – Article 16ba – § 4 (corresponds to
Article 1, § 1, point 5) – 174
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulations (EC) No 261/2004, (EC) No 1107/2006, (EU) No 1177/2010, (EU) No 181/2011 and (EU) 2021/782 as regards enforcement of passenger rights in the Union
part_text: 4. Compliance monitoring activities shall be based on the assessment of risks and carried out by means of audits, inspections, interviews, verifications and examination of documents as appropriate. They shall include both announced and unannounced activities. The monitoring activities shall be proportionate to the risks identified. National enforcement bodies shall take into account the size and administrative capacity of the operators concerned and shall avoid imposing unnecessary or disproportionate administrative burdens, in particular on small and medium-sized enterprises.
